parameters.query:
UPDATE data_operations AS d
SET
    status_concept_ref = pairs.status_concept_ref,
    performed_at = CASE WHEN pairs.status_concept_ref = 29 THEN NOW() ELSE d.performed_at END,
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM (
    SELECT
        r.value AS read_ref,
        (s.value)::int AS status_concept_ref
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(value, idx)
    JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS s(value, idx2)
      ON r.idx = s.idx2
) AS pairs
WHERE d.read_ref = pairs.read_ref::int;

parameters.content: Basıbuyuk ve pendik için marmara patoloji maili, geri kalanlar için op_ref maili

parameters.command: =printf '%s' '{{ $json.b64 }}' | base64 -d | jq -r '.[] | .items[] | [.recipe_ref, .sample_id, .r1_path, .r2_path] | @tsv' | while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r recipe sample r1 r2; do ok=true; reasons=""; if [ ! -f "$r1" ]; then ok=false; reasons="${reasons}$(basename "$r1"): missing; "; fi; if [ ! -f "$r2" ]; then ok=false; reasons="${reasons}$(basename "$r2"): missing; "; fi; echo "${recipe}|${sample}|${ok}|${reasons}"; done | jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0)) | map(split("|") as $p | {recipe_ref: $p[0], sample_id: $p[1], ok: ($p[2] == "true"), reason: $p[3]}) | {all_ok: (map(.ok) | all), failed: map(select(.ok | not)), results: .}'
